name: com.borderjung.unity-modules
description: Reusable Unity modules by BorderJung, bundled as a single package. Core (build-stripped Log), Events (SO event channels), SaveLoad (JSON), Localization (SO table + ILocalizationProvider), Settings (SO-driven settings + ISettingsRepository), and shared UI.

samples.description: Localization/Settings/UI 데모 프리팹·SO·이벤트 채널을 한 번에 임포트. 폰트=LiberationSans SDF, 스프라이트=Unity 기본으로 치환됨.
